rule.screen: 48 predeclared genomes; LOW dailyADX, no inherited stretch on new members; all outcomes retained
rule.selection: 2024+2025 only; BOTH/LONG/SHORT proposals; positive and>=12 trades EACH fitting year; rank minimum annual net/trade; at most6 and1/family; ties lexicographic
rule.raw_pass: positive every year;>=8/year,>=40total;>=5/6 nonnegative halves; positive without each year best day; weekly t>=2; max-t four-week signflip p<=.05
rule.exact_pass: better than MAIN every year; paired weekly t>=2; annual fall<=MAIN+.01; zero unresolved
rule.honesty: all three years seen; folds/subsets only exploratory; no fresh qualification or changes to2023 exam
